name: AnyAPI
description: 400-model gateway whose free plan meters 100K ANY tokens a day with no card.
overview: AnyAPI puts 400+ models — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cohere — behind one OpenAI-compatible key. The Free plan costs $0 a month, needs no credit card and meters 100,000 ANY tokens per day against the models its catalogue marks free; paid plans start at $20 of usage-based credit. Which model IDs are free is only visible in the logged-in catalogue, so the rows here are the free models its directory names publicly.
free_access: Free model set is visible only after login
notes: The ANY-token unit is not 1:1 with model tokens; the free model list rotates inside the dashboard.
